description: This is another great deck type. with the restriction of the darkside to one jedi this decktype will be predominate in the current ep1 enviroument till Theed Palace comes out.
cards: We'll Handle This / Duel Of The Fates

posted: Naboo theed Palace Generator core
posted: Speak With the Jedi Council
notes: Posted 14 November 2001, before Theed Palace (12 December 2001), so the format is Premiere - Reflections III. The list still names two Theed Palace cards, Gimme A Lift! and Amidala's Blaster; they are kept as posted.
The description calls this a deck for the 'current ep1 environment', but the list also runs Dagobah Control, Sense and Alter, so it is not an Episode I-only deck.

Starting cards as posted under 'Starting|9|': We'll Handle This / Duel Of The Fates, Inner Strength, Naboo: Theed Palace Generator, Naboo: Theed Palace Generator Core, Podrace Prep, Tatooine: Podrace Arena, Anakin's Podracer, Boonta Eve Podrace, Brisky Morning Munchen; these count toward the 60.
The list totals 59 as published: the 'Characters |15|' section names only 14 cards. Jar Jar's Electropole x7 is kept as posted.
Posted 'Yoda' dested Yoda, Senior Council Member (Coruscant): the strategy downloads Yoda to the Jedi Council Chamber, which only the Episode I Yoda can do; Dagobah Yoda must deploy on Dagobah.

Posted 'Padme' dested Padme Naberrie; 'Jar Jar' dested Jar Jar Binks; 'naked 3po' dested Threepio With His Parts Showing; 'Maul's Demise' dested Darth Maul's Demise; 'Qui-gon's Saber' dested Qui-Gon's Lightsaber; 'Jedi Council Chamber' dested Coruscant: Jedi Council Chamber.
